content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To make buttercream fondant, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Whip the butter until pale and fluffy (10 minutes)
Step 2. Gradually incorporate the corn syrup into the base (5 minutes)
Step 3. Sift the first batch of confectioners' sugar (15 minutes)
Step 4. Add the vanilla bean paste to the sugar (2 minutes)
Step 5. Soften the vegetable shortening in the microwave (30 seconds)
Step 6. Knead the mixture on a clean surface (20 minutes)
Step 7. Measure out the liquid glucose (3 minutes)
Step 8. Melt the marshmallows with a tablespoon of water (4 minutes)
Step 9. Cream the butter and shortening together (8 minutes)
Step 10. Incorporate the heavy cream (2 minutes)
Step 11. Scrape down the sides of the mixing bowl (1 minute)
Step 12. Sanitize all mixing equipment (15 minutes)
Step 13. Prepare the workspace with non-stick mats (5 minutes)
Step 14. Mix in the glycerin (1 minute)
Step 15. Check the consistency of the paste (2 minutes)
Step 16. Add a pinch of salt to balance sweetness (30 seconds)
Step 17. Organize all dry and wet ingredients (10 minutes)
Step 18. Slowly beat in the remaining sugar (12 minutes)
Step 19. Sift the cocoa powder for chocolate flavor (5 minutes)
Step 20. Calibrate the kitchen scale (5 minutes)
Step 21. Apply food coloring gels (10 minutes)
Step 22. Dissolve the gelatin in cold water (10 minutes)
Step 23. Whisk in the almond extract (1 minute)
Step 24. Purchase high-quality powdered sugar (1 hour)
Step 25. Heat the mixture over a double boiler (7 minutes)
Step 26. Dust the rolling pin with cornstarch (1 minute)
Step 27. Combine the glucose and melted butter (4 minutes)
Step 28. Fold in the lemon zest (3 minutes)
Step 29. Check the room temperature for stability (1 minute)
Step 30. Drive to the specialty baking store (45 minutes)
Step 31. Reserve a small portion of white fondant (2 minutes)
Step 32. Wrap the fondant tightly in plastic wrap (5 minutes)
Step 33. Sift the second batch of confectioners' sugar (15 minutes)
Step 34. Let the fondant rest at room temperature (24 hours)
Step 35. Microwave the fondant for five seconds to soften (5 seconds)
Step 36. Add a teaspoon of tylose powder for firmness (1 minute)
Step 37. Prepare the storage containers (10 minutes)
Step 38. Smooth the surface of the fondant (10 minutes)
Step 39. Inventory the pantry for ingredients (15 minutes)
Step 40. Test the elasticity of the dough (2 minutes)
Step 41. Roll the fondant to a quarter-inch thickness (15 minutes)
Step 42. Blend in the white food coloring (5 minutes)
Step 43. Clean the mixing paddles (10 minutes)
Step 44. Measure the shortening precisely (5 minutes)
Step 45. Open a new bag of marshmallows (1 minute)
Step 46. Trim the edges of the fondant sheet (5 minutes)
Step 47. Wipe down the counter with vinegar (5 minutes)
Step 48. Store the fondant in an airtight container (2 minutes)
Step 49. Label the containers with the date (2 minutes)
Step 50. Separate the egg whites if using royal icing (5 minutes)
Step 51. Boil water for the double boiler (10 minutes)
Step 52. Knead in the vegetable shortening (8 minutes)
Step 53. Melt the white chocolate chips (3 minutes)
Step 54. Read the entire recipe thoroughly (20 minutes)
Step 55. Add the lemon juice to prevent crusting (1 minute)
Step 56. Weigh the final batch of fondant (3 minutes)
Step 57. Sift the cornstarch and sugar together (10 minutes)
Step 58. Adjust the moisture with a drop of water (1 minute)
Step 59. Sharpen the fondant trimmer (5 minutes)
Step 60. Clean the work surface of all sugar dust (10 minutes)
Step 61. Lightly grease your hands with shortening (1 minute)
Step 62. Beat the mixture on medium speed (10 minutes)
Step 63. Prepare the flavoring extracts (5 minutes)
Step 64. Apply a thin layer of shortening to the fondant surface (2 minutes)
Step 65. Measure the butter (2 minutes)
Step 66. Set out the mixing bowls (5 minutes)
Step 67. Check the expiration dates on the glycerin (2 minutes)
Step 68. Place the fondant in a cool, dark place (5 minutes)
Step 69. Clean the sifter (10 minutes)
Step 70. Lightly flour the work area (2 minutes)
Step 71. Prepare the hot water bath (8 minutes)
Step 72. Dust the fondant with additional sugar (2 minutes)
Step 73. Pour the liquid ingredients into the dry well (3 minutes)
Step 74. Double-bag the fondant for extra protection (2 minutes)
Step 75. Incorporate the final bits of sugar by hand (15 minutes)
Step 76. Wash the measuring spoons (5 minutes)
Step 77. Sift the third batch of confectioners' sugar (15 minutes)
Step 78. Place the fondant in a heavy-duty freezer bag (2 minutes)
Step 79. Smooth out any air bubbles (5 minutes)
Step 80. Clear the kitchen counter (10 minutes)
Step 81. Sift the fourth batch of confectioners' sugar (15 minutes)
Step 82. Set the timer for the mixing stages (1 minute)
Step 83. Check for any lumps in the dough (5 minutes)
Step 84. Wipe the outside of the storage bags (2 minutes)
Step 85. Place the mixer on the counter (2 minutes)
Step 86. Dry the mixing bowl thoroughly (3 minutes)
Step 87. Melt the remaining shortening (2 minutes)
Step 88. Polish the rolling pin (5 minutes)
Step 89. Sift the fifth batch of confectioners' sugar (15 minutes)
Step 90. Lay out the silicone mats (2 minutes)
